description: This file contains React utility hooks and functions for UI state management, including measurement, timing, string formatting, settings management, and other React hooks.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A class managing application settings stored in localStorage with change event notifications.

methods.name: useAsyncMemo
methods.description: Recalculates the value asynchronously when dependencies change.

methods.name: useMeasure
methods.description: Tracks the size of a DOM element and returns its contentRect.

methods.name: msToString
methods.description: Converts milliseconds to a human-readable string.

methods.name: bytesToString
methods.description: Converts byte counts to a human-readable string.

methods.name: lowerBound
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find the lower bound index in a sorted array.

methods.name: upperBound
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find the upper bound index in a sorted array.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies text to clipboard using a temporary textarea element.

methods.name: useSetting
methods.description: React hook for managing a setting stored in localStorage with automatic updates.

methods.name: sha1
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of a string asynchronously.

methods.name: scrollIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls an element into view if it is not already visible.

methods.name: useFlash
methods.description: Manages a flash animation state that triggers for a second when activated.
